blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ranked heads for both few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Together, these findings provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context and suggest that (soft) parameter reuse shapes how this ability develops and which attention mechanisms support it.
blocks.zh: 循环和深度发展的语言模型跨深度再利用计算,并引起了对其推理能力的兴趣。 根据先前关于改进内文学习的明显证据,我们调查这种再利用如何有利于《国际商业法》,包括它如何塑造这种能力的获取、保留和机制。 我们的分析跨越了预先训练的语言模型,最多可达3B参数和可控任务. 这些实验提供了证据,证明对从上下文学习有共同的诱导偏好:在上下文中,成长和循环的模型更多地依赖信息,与充分深入的参考相比,在控制任务中更早地获得ICL,并在也有可能学习权重中的固定关联时更强烈地保留它. 通过培训追踪关注头,发现深度增长将早期上岗头像传播到各个层次。 缩写显示,成长和循环的模型在少发性能和后发性能的预测中,都更依赖感应级头. 这些结论共同提供了证据,证明对从上下文中学习具有共同的诱导性偏见,并表明(软的)参数再利用决定了这种能力的发展方式以及支持这种能力的注意机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: How a language model acquires its depth can shape the computations it learns. Depth growing trains an initially shallow network and progressively duplicates blocks of layers, allowing later training stages to reuse computations learned earlier. Looping instead repeatedly applies a shared block within each forward pass. Originally motivated by training efficiency ( Fahlman and Lebiere, 1989 ) and parameter efficiency, respectively, both approaches have attracted renewed interest for their reasoning capabilities ( Saunshi et al., 2024 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ) . Although grown layers become independent after duplication, whereas looped layers remain tied, the two approaches can produce related patterns of iterative computation across depth ( Kapl et al., 2026a ; Kapl et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型如何获得它的深度可以塑造它所学习的计算. 深度增长训练最初是一个浅层网络并逐渐地重复地层块,使得后期训练阶段能够再利用早先学到的计算. 循环在每一个前传中反复应用一个共享块. 最初的动机分别是培训效率(Fahlman和Lebiere,1989年)和参数效率,这两种方法都引起了对其推理能力的新兴趣(Saunshi等人,2024年;Saunshi等人,2025年;Geiping等人,2025年)。 虽然已成型的地层在重复后独立,而循环地层仍然被捆绑,但这两种方法可以产生跨深度迭代计算的相关模式(Kapl等人,2026a; Kapl等, 2026b ).

blocks.en: This reuse of computation may also favor in-context learning (ICL), as suggested by initial evidence in both grown and looped models ( Kapl et al., 2026b ) . ICL is the ability to use information supplied in a prompt or sequence without updating the model’s parameters ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . A model that repeatedly refines its representations might also be better equipped to extract and apply patterns from context. Yet, improved reasoning performance alone does not establish this ability. Predictions can rely on associations stored in the weights, on information inferred from the current sequence, or on both. Moreover, a model’s improvement in predicting later tokens and its ability to learn a task from demonstrations are related but distinct measurements, with potentially different underlying mechanisms ( Olsson et al., 2022 ; Yin and Steinhardt, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种重复使用计算还可能有利于文字内学习(ICL),这是生长模型和循环模型(Kapl等,2026b.)的初步证据所显示的。 ICL是使用以即时或顺序提供的信息而不更新模型参数的能力(Brown等,2020年). 一个反复完善其表述模式的模型也许还可以更好地从上下文中提取和应用模式。 然而,仅凭推理表现的改善并不能确定这种能力。 预测可以依靠存储在权重中的关联,依靠从当前序列推断出的信息,也可以依靠两者. 此外,模型在预测后期征兆方面的改进及其从演示中学习任务的能力是相关但截然不同的衡量标准,其潜在的基本机制不同(Olsson等,2022;Yin和Steinhardt,2025)。

blocks.en: Prior work provides promising evidence for a connection between depth reuse and ICL. Looped Transformers can learn synthetic regression and other data-fitting tasks with substantially fewer parameters than standard Transformers ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Von Oswald et al., 2023 ) . Studies of pretrained language models also report improved adaptation from demonstrations in grown and looped models for synthetic reasoning tasks ( Kapl et al., 2026b ) . Concurrently, Wang et al. (2026) report stronger gains with increasing context length and demonstration count in compute-matched looped mixture-of-experts models. What remains less understood is how these behavioral differences arise during training: whether growing and looping favor a context-based solution when memorization is also possible, how they affect the persistence of that solution, and how changes in attention-head mechanisms relate to the different measures of ICL.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作为深度再利用与ICL之间的联系提供了有希望的证据。 循环变换器可以学习合成还原和其他数据匹配任务,其参数大大低于标准变换器(杨等,2024;冯·奥斯瓦尔德等,2023. 对经过预先培训的语言模型的研究也报告说,在合成推理任务中,从已成长和循环模型的演示中改进了适应性(Kapl等,2026b.)。 同时 Wang等人(2026年)报告说,在计算相匹配的循环专家混合模型中,环境长度和演示计数都有所增加,收益更大。 仍然不太理解的是,这些行为差异是如何在训练期间出现的:当记忆也是可能的时,是否增长和循环支持一种基于上下文的解决方案,它们如何影响该解决方案的持久性,以及关注点机制的变化如何与ICL的不同度量相关.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate these questions through complementary experiments on natural language and controlled tasks. We compare dense baselines with depth-grown and looped models on language-model configurations with dense reference sizes from 360M to 3B parameters. We measure position-dependent token loss and scaling with the number of demonstrations for few-shot learning. We then use RegBench ( Akyürek et al., 2024 ) to study learning previously unseen formal languages, and Omniglot-based tasks ( Chan et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) to separate learning from context from learning fixed associations in the weights. Finally, we track induction and function-vector heads through training and intervene on them in the final models. Our contributions are the following:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过自然语言和受控任务的互补实验来调查这些问题. 我们用360M到3B参数的密集参考大小,将密度基线与语言模型配置的深度和循环模型进行比较。 我们衡量依赖位置的标志性损失,并按少发学习的示范次数进行衡量。 然后,我们利用Reg Bench(Akyürek等,2024年)研究以前未见的正式语言的学习,以及基于Omniglot的任务(Chan等,2022年;Singh等,2023年),将学习从权重中学习固定的关联中分离出来. 最后,我们通过培训跟踪上岗和职能主管,并在最后模式中对他们进行干预。 我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en:
• Grown and looped language models benefit more from context. In the main 3B language-model comparison, both achieve larger early-to-late token-loss reductions than the dense baseline, with the grown model also attaining lower absolute late-token loss. Both models also achieve higher GSM8K accuracy across all demonstration counts. On RegBench, grown and looped models predict unseen formal languages more accurately, with their advantage emerging within the first string ( Figures 1 and 2 ). • Growing and looping favor earlier acquisition and stronger retention of ICL. In controlled Omniglot tasks where both context and fixed class–label associations can solve training queries, grown and looped models retain higher ICL accuracy and exhibit lower in-weights learning (IWL) accuracy than the full-depth dense reference. When labels are reassigned in every sequence, removing a fixed class–label solution, both acquire ICL earlier than the same reference ( Figure 3 ). • Depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Tracing final induction heads backward through training shows that strong heads in the grown model predominantly descend from heads already exhibiting strong induction behavior in early growing stages. Layer duplication produces repeated patterns of this behavior across depth, while looped models exhibit analogous patterns across successive applications of their shared looped block ( Figures 4 and 5 ). • Grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction heads for ICL. In the main language-model comparison, ablating induction-ranked heads causes larger drops in few-shot performance and larger increases in late-token loss than in the dense baseline.
These interventions establish a greater contribution from induction-ranked heads to both behaviors, while function-vector heads remain important ( Figure 6 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Model growth reduces training cost by starting with a smaller network ( Fahlman and Lebiere, 1989 ) . Language-model approaches use layer copying and progressive stacking ( Gong et al., 2019 ; Reddi et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , learned transformations between model sizes ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , or masked and function-preserving expansions ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2015 ; Gesmundo and Maile, 2023 ) . Growth operators also shape model capabilities: MIDAS duplicates a central block of layers and improves reasoning at comparable language-model capabilities ( Saunshi et al., 2024 ) . Kapl et al. (2026a) find stronger reliance on later layers in grown models and propose LIDAS , which duplicates layers around the network’s center independently of existing block boundaries.
blocks.zh: 模式增长从较小的网络开始,降低了培训费用(Fahlman和Lebiere,1989年)。 语言模型方法使用层相复制和渐进堆放(龚等,2019;Reddi等,2023;Kim等,2024;Du等,2024;),模型大小间所学变相(王等,2023;),或被遮掩和功能保留扩展(姚等,2024;陈等,2015;格斯蒙多和迈勒,2023. 增长运营商还塑造模型能力: MIDAS重复了一层地层的中心块并改进了具有可比语言模型能力的推理(Saunshi等,2024.). Kapl 等 (2026a) 在已成型的模型中发现更依赖后层, 并提议LIDAS,

blocks.en: Cross-layer parameter sharing provides computational depth with fewer weights, as in Universal Transformers ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) , recurrent stacking for translation ( Dabre and Fujita, 2019 ) , and ALBERT ( Lan et al., 2020 ) , while Takase and Kiyono (2023) study its design choices. Extensions add layer-specific low-rank adapters ( Bae et al., 2025 ) or mixture-of-experts capacity ( Csordás et al., 2024 ) . Recurrence has also been studied for algorithmic length generalization ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , latent reasoning ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ) , and inference-time computation scaling ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Other work retrofits recurrence into pretrained models ( McLeish et al., 2025 ; Koishekenov et al., 2025 ) or explores hierarchical and compact recursive architectures for iterative refinement ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 跨层参数共享提供计算深度并减少权重,如"通用变形器"(Dehghani等,2019年),为翻译而经常堆放(Dabre和Fujita,2019年)和"ALBERT"(Lan等,2020年),而"高濑"和"清野"(Kiyono (2023年)研究其设计选择. 扩展会添加分层特定的低等适配器(Bae等,2025年)或专家混合能力(Csordás等,2024年). 还研究了重复性算法长度一般化(Fan等,2025年),潜入推理(Saunshi等,2025年)和推算时间缩放(Geiping等,2025年;Zhu等,2025年)。 其他工作则将再现改造为预先训练过的模型(McLeish等,2025;Koishekenov等,2025;或探索分级和紧凑的递归结构来进行迭代改进(Wang等,2025;Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025.).

blocks.en: ICL enables adaptation from demonstrations without parameter updates ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Studies show that Transformers infer unseen functions from examples ( Garg et al., 2022 ) , learn gradient-descent-like computations in restricted regression settings ( Von Oswald et al., 2023 ; Gatmiry et al., 2024 ) , and can be programmed to execute learning algorithms in context ( Giannou et al., 2023 ) . Data properties such as burstiness and dynamic meanings encourage ICL ( Chan et al., 2022 ) , which can decline as persistent associations are learned in the weights ( Singh et al., 2023 ) . Other work connects regular-language learning to in-context n n -gram heads on RegBench ( Akyürek et al., 2024 ) and studies context-dependent representations and their competition with pretrained semantics through graph tracing ( Park et al., 2025 ) . These settings let us probe context use with and without competing in-weights solutions.
blocks.zh: ICL使得无需参数更新即可从演示中适应(Brown等人,2020年). 研究表明"变形器"从实例(Garg等,2022年)中推断出不可见的函数,在受限回归环境下学习梯度-去德等计算(Von Oswald等,2023年;Gatmiry等,2024年),可以编程在上下文中执行学习算法(Giannou等,2023年). 爆发和活性意义等数据属性鼓励了ICL(Chan等,2022年),随着在权重中学习到持久关联(Singh等,2023年),这些数据属性可以下降. 其他工作将正规语言学习与Reg Bench上的n-gram头连接起来(Akyürek等,2024年),并通过图谱追踪研究依具体情况而定的表述及其与预修语义的竞争(Park等,2025年)。 这些设置可以让我们探究上下文是否使用与重量内相竞争的解决方案。

blocks.en: Induction heads support pattern copying and are associated with improved later-token prediction ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Their formation has been studied in controlled synthetic tasks ( Singh et al., 2024 ) and language-model pretraining ( Aoyama et al., 2026 ) . Function-vector heads transmit task representations from demonstrations ( Todd et al., 2024 ) . Yin and Steinhardt (2025) find that few-shot performance depends primarily on these heads, many of which first exhibit induction behavior.
blocks.zh: 上岗头支持复制模式,并与改进后台预测有关(Elhage等,2021;Olsson等,2022)。 他们的形成在受控合成任务(Singh等,2024年)和语言模型预训(Aoyama等,2026年)中被研究. 职能主管负责转交示威活动的任务说明(Todd等人,2024年)。 殷和斯泰因哈特(2025年)发现少发性能主要依赖于这些头部,其中许多头部首先表现出了感应行为.

blocks.en: Looped Transformers can match standard Transformers on synthetic data-fitting tasks with substantially fewer parameters ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Concurrent work ( Wang et al., 2026 ) reports gains that increase with sequence length and demonstration count in looped mixture-of-experts language models under matched compute, parameter, and KV-cache budgets .
blocks.zh: 循环变换器可以在合成数据匹配任务上与标准变换器相匹配,参数要少得多(Yang等,2024.). 同时期工作(Wang等,2026年)报告,在相应计算、参数和KV-cache预算下,在循环的专家混合语言模型中,随着序列长度和演示计数而增加的收益。

blocks.en: Most closely related, Kapl et al. (2026b) identify shared depth-wise computational patterns in grown and looped models, show that grown models can benefit from inference-time repetition, and report improved adaptation from demonstrations on reasoning primitives. We extend this evidence to ICL acquisition, retention, and mechanisms across pretrained language models and controlled tasks. We test whether growing and looping favor context use when memorization is possible, trace induction heads through layer duplication, and ablate induction and function-vector heads to assess their contributions to few-shot learning and token prediction.
blocks.zh: 最密切相关的是,Kapl等人(2026年b)在已成型和环绕型模型中识别出共享的深度相通计算模式,显示已成型的模型可以从推论时间重复中受益,并报告从推理原始学演示中改进了适应性. 我们把这一证据扩展到国际语言学研究所的获取、保留以及跨越预先训练的语言模型和控制任务的机制。 我们测试在记忆可能时是否使用增长和循环的上下文,通过层层重复来追踪感应头,并减少感应头和函数向导头,以评估它们对几发学习和象征性预测的贡献。

blocks.en: 3 In-Context Learning of Depth-Grown and Looped Models
blocks.zh: 3 深度浏览和循环模型的内在学习

blocks.en: We first examine how growing and looping affect learning from context. After introducing the models and measures ( Section 3.1 ), we evaluate context use in language models ( Section 3.2 ), adaptation to unseen formal languages on RegBench ( Section 3.3 ), and ICL with and without an in-weights solution on Omniglot ( Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查增长和循环如何影响从背景中学习。 在引入模型和措施(第3.1节)后,我们评价语言模型中的背景使用情况(第3.2节),在Reg Bench上对不见正式语言的适应(第3.3节),以及在Omniglot上有无加权解决方案的ICL(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Grown and looped models benefit more from context. In the 3B comparison, grown and looped models show greater context gains in (a) NLL relative to the dense baseline and (b) early-to-late loss reduction relative to the baseline per token position, although the looped model retains higher NLL. Both panels aggregate token losses in the same power-of-two position bins: (a) compares the binned loss directly with the baseline, whereas (b) first computes each model’s improvement from a fixed early token position (50) to the bin ending at x x and then subtracts the baseline’s improvement. blocks.en: A dense model trains L L independently parameterized Transformer layers from scratch. A depth-grown model instead begins with a shallower model and periodically duplicates a block of layers, after which the copies train independently. The main paper focuses on LIDAS ( Kapl et al., 2026a ) , which selects the central layers without respecting earlier block boundaries. Comparisons with MIDAS ( Saunshi et al., 2024 ) and at other model sizes (360M and 1.7B) appear in Section A.3 . The language models start with block size b = 4 b=4 layers and add b b layers at each growth event, copying both weights and optimizer moments while retaining the training schedule.

blocks.en: In-Context Learning Measures. We evaluate language models using next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL, lower is better), a token-loss ICL-Score ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , and few-shot task performance. The ICL-Score measures the reduction in mean NLL from early positions 40–60 ("50") to later positions 490–510 ("500"), with higher values indicating greater early-to-late improvement. We use these token-loss windows to smooth potential single token position spikes and refer to the positions in the following by a single position for simplicity. In Figure 1 (b), we instead average later losses over power-of-two bins ending at x x , keeping the early reference fixed. This measures improvement within each model, while we report individual token loss separately. Few-shot performance is measured through benchmark accuracy or token-overlap F1. Full protocols are given in Appendix B .

ICL-分数衡量了NLL的平均值从早期位置40–60 ("50")降低到后期位置490–510 ("500"),更高的值表明早期到晚期的改善更大. 我们利用这些失去标志的窗口来平滑潜在的单一标志性位置标记,并用单一位置来指代下面的位置,以简洁. 在图1(b)中,我们平均是以后因以xx为终点的两箱电源而造成的损失,使早期的参考值保持不变。 这一措施在每一种模式中都有所改进,而我们则单独报告个别象征性损失。 很少镜头的性能通过基准精度或令牌重叠F1来衡量. 完整的协议载于附录B。

blocks.en: 3.2 Context Use in Language Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 语言模型中使用的背景

blocks.en: We first compare how the different models use additional context in sequence modeling and few-shot tasks. These evaluations distinguish improvement with more context from absolute performance relative to the dense baseline. For sequence modeling, the depth-grown and looped models are worse at predicting early tokens compared to the baseline ( Figure 1 (a)), with the biggest gap for very early tokens (token index ≤ 8 \leq 8 ). After this peak, both models improve the prediction of tokens by lowering their NLL more, making better use of more tokens in the context. This is especially apparent when measuring the improvement of later tokens versus a fixed early position (50) and comparing it to the improvement of the baseline ( Figure 1 (b)). The looped model, which uses significantly fewer unique parameters, retains higher NLL than the baseline even at the end of the sequence. LIDAS matches the baseline around position 1000 and achieves lower NLL thereafter (solid line) and on average across positions (dashed line).
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较不同模型如何在序列建模和几发任务中使用额外的上下文. 这些评价将改进与相对于密集基线的绝对业绩区分开来。 就序列模型而言,与基线(图1(a))相比,深度和循环模型在预测早期信号时更为糟糕,对于非常早期的信号来说,差距最大(托肯指数为\\8\leq 8)。 在这个峰值后,两个模型都通过降低更多的NLL来改进了对符的预测,在上下文中更好地利用了更多的符. 这在衡量较后期信使相对于固定的早期位置(50个)的改进情况并将其同基准的改进相比较(图1(b))。 循环模型使用的独特参数明显较少,即使在序列末端也保留了比基线更高的NLL. LIDAS与1000位置周围的基线相匹配,并在此后实现较低的NLL(固线)并平均跨位置(干线).

blocks.en: On GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) few-shot accuracy in Figure 1 (c), the looped model, again using fewer parameters, keeps its advantage over the baseline across demonstration counts, but the baseline almost closes the gap at eight shots. The depth-grown model instead widens its performance improvement gap with additional examples, ending up around + 7 % +7\% above the baseline. GSM8K evaluates final answers extracted from generated solutions to new questions, so these gains reflect improved answer generation from in-context demonstrations, a setting relevant to practical few-shot prompting. As an additional comparison, Appendix Figure 9 reports separate averages over five multiple-choice and three generation tasks. At 3B, LIDAS improves on the baseline in both subsets, while the looped model’s advantage is concentrated in generation.
blocks.zh: 在GSM8K上(Cobbe等,2021年)图1(c)中几发精度,被环绕的模型再次使用较少的参数,保持了相对于基准的优势,跨越了演示计数,但基线几乎以8发精度收紧了缺口. 深层模型反而用更多的实例扩大了其性能改进差距,最终比基线高出了7%。 GSM8K评价从新问题生成的解决方案中取出的最后答案,因此这些成果反映了从内文演示中改进的答案生成,这种设定与实际的几发提示相关. 作为补充比较,附录图9报告将5个多选择和3个一代任务的平均数分开。 在3B时,LIDAS在两个子集中都改进了基线,而被环绕的模型的优势集中在生成上.

blocks.en: 3.3 In-Context Learning Languages: RegBench Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.3 文中学习语言:Reg Bench数据集

blocks.en: RegBench ( Akyürek et al., 2024 ) tests adaptation to an unseen formal language. Each input concatenates strings sampled from one deterministic finite automaton (DFA), with held-out automata used for testing. We measure total variation distance (TVD) between the predicted next-symbol distribution and the uniform distribution over legal continuations. All models apply twelve layers per forward pass, with two unique layers for the looped model.
blocks.zh: Reg Bench(Akyürek等,2024年)测试了对一种看不见的正式语言的适应. 每种输入都从一个确定性的有限自動相機(DFA)中抽取出字符串,并用被搁置的自動相機来做测试. 我们测量预测的下同位素分布与合法续作的统一分布之间的总相差(TVD). 所有模型每个前传都应用了十二层,循环模型有两个独特的层.

blocks.en: In Figure 2 (a), the grown and looped models achieve lower TVD than the dense baseline on novel languages. Their advantage increases over the first few strings, peaking around the fourth ( Figure 2 (b)). When zooming in on the test sequences in Figure 2 (c), both alternative training variants adapt faster to the new language by predicting symbols (akin to characters or tokens) within the first string better after roughly 15 symbols. Additionally, on average, after the first string the grown and looped model do not continue to increase their advantage with more symbols but keep a constant improvement. Appendix Figure 12 extends the comparison including DFA accuracy and additional grown models also evaluated with four training seeds, with the precise setup in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 3.4 In-Context and In-Weights Learning: Omniglot
blocks.zh: 3.4 内文和内文学习:Omniglot

blocks.en: We next examine learning from context when fixed associations can also be stored in the weights, or when labels vary between sequences, removing the in-weights learning (IWL) solution. For that purpose, we use the Omniglot image-classification setup of Chan et al. (2022) . Each sequence contains eight image–label pairs followed by a query image. In the fixed-label setting, every training class has a persistent label and the query class always appears among the context examples, with P ⁡ ( bursty ) = 1 P(\mathrm{bursty})=1 , meaning that every training sequence contains multiple demonstrations of the same classes. The training query can therefore be answered either by matching it to the current examples in context or by learning its class–label association in the weights. We distinguish these capabilities with two probes: ICL accuracy on held-out classes with labels reassigned in each sequence, and IWL accuracy on training classes whose query class is absent from context. We compare dense models with 4 and 12 layers, a Loop ⁡ 4 × 3 \LoopOp\,4{\mkern-1.5mu\times\mkern-1.5mu}3 model, and a LIDAS -grown model that expands from 4 to 8 layers at 50k steps and to 12 layers at 100k steps. All models have the same hidden width and use the same optimizer and batch size. We average over four training seeds for the fixed-label setting and eight for the ICL-only setting below. Appendix D gives the full setup.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来研究从上下文中学习,当固定关联也可以被存储在权重中,或者当标签在序列之间变化时,去除权重学习(IWL)溶液. 为此,我们使用了Chan等人(2022年)的Omniglot图像分类设置. 每个序列包含8个图像-标签对并后加一个查询图像. 在固定标签设置中,每门训练课都有一个持久的标签,查询课总是出现在上下文实例中,其中P QQ (bludy) = 1 P (\mathrm{bursty})= 1,这意味着每门训练课的序列都包含同门课的多个演示. 因此,可以通过在上下文中将其与当前实例相匹配或者在权重中学习其类标签关联来回答培训询问。 我们用两个探测器来区分这些能力:被扣课上的ICL精度,每个序列的标签被重新分配;以及训练课上的IWL精度,其查询课没有上下文. 我们比较了密集模型与4和12层,一个Loop QQ 4 × 3\LoopOp\,4\mkern-1.5mu\times\mkern-1.5mu}3模型,以及一个LIDAS-自成型模型,在50k步上从4到8层,在100k步上扩展到12层. 所有型号都具有相同的隐藏宽度并使用相同的优化器和批量大小. 我们平均在固定标签设置方面有4个以上训练种子,在下面只有ICL设置方面有8个。 附 录 D给出了完整的设置。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows an early rise in ICL followed by a gradual decline as IWL improves, reflecting the transience of ICL observed by Singh et al. (2023) . Over the shared training horizon, the grown and looped models retain higher mean ICL accuracy but lower IWL accuracy than the dense 12-layer model. The grown model has similar ICL and IWL accuracies to its four-layer reference, from which it first grows at 50k steps. The looped model attains similar ICL accuracy to the grown model but significantly lower IWL accuracy. These trajectories are consistent with growing and looping favoring learning from context relative to the full-depth dense model at the same effective depth. For looped models, this can come at the cost of weaker in-weights learning, while the grown model appears to inherit both capabilities from its shallow starting model.
blocks.zh: 图3(a)显示,随着IWL的改善,ICL提前上升,随后逐渐下降,反映了Singh等人(2023年)观察到的ICL的转瞬即逝. 在共享的训练地平线上,已成长和循环的模型保留了更高的平均ICL精度,但比密集的12层模型更低的IWL精度. 已成型的模型有相相近的ICL和IWL快取法与它的四层参考,从中它首先以50k阶来生长. 被环绕的模型取得了与所生长的模型相类似的ICL精度,但明显地降低了IWL精度. 这些轨迹与增长和循环一致,有利于从上下文中学习,而不是在同样有效深度的全深度密集模型。 对于被环绕的模型来说,这可能会以较弱的体重学习为代价,而已成型的模型似乎从它的浅薄起步模型中继承了两种能力.

blocks.en: To test acquisition when a fixed class–label solution is unavailable (ICL-only), we train a different set of models with labels 0 and 1 reassigned independently in every sequence, mirroring the ICL probing setup on training images. Each sequence contains two classes with four examples each, followed by a query from one of them. In Figure 3 (b), ICL accuracy emerges earlier for the looped, grown, and four-layer dense models than for the dense 12-layer model. By 1M steps, all four tested configurations almost reach 100%. Thus, this setting does not differentiate how much ICL is attained but rather the timing and consistency of ICL emergence, given that ICL is the only correct solution to the training problem.
blocks.zh: 为了测试在固定类-标签解决方案无法使用(仅使用ICL)时的获取,我们训练了一套不同的型号,每个序列都独立地重新分配了标签0和1,在训练图像上镜像了ICL的检测设置. 每个序列包含两个类,每个类有4个实例,然后由其中之一进行查询. 在图3(b)中,环绕、生长和四层密集模型的ICL精度比密集的12层模型早出。 到1M步,所有四个被测试的配置几乎都达到了100%. 因此,这种设置并不区分在多大程度上达到国际计算机定位标准,而是考虑到国际计算机定位标准是解决培训问题的唯一正确办法,因而并不区分国际计算机定位标准出现的时间和一致性。

blocks.en: 4 Growing and Looping Increase Reliance on Induction Heads
blocks.zh: 4 成长和循环增加对上岗头的依赖

blocks.en: The behavioral results suggest that growing and looping favor learning from context. Returning to language models, we examine the attention mechanisms supporting this behavior. We first track induction behavior during training and across layers ( Section 4.1 ), then ablate heads to test their contribution to context use ( Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 行为结果表明,人们越来越倾向于从上下文中学习。 回到语言模型,我们研究支持这种行为的注意力机制. 我们首先跟踪培训期间和跨层的上岗行为(第4.1节),然后将头部放高,以测试其对上下文使用的贡献(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Depth Growth Propagates Early Induction Heads
blocks.zh: 4.1 深度增长传播 早期上岗头

blocks.en: Attention-Head Measures. We characterize attention heads using prefix-matching (PS) and function-vector (FV) scores. PS measures attention to the token following an earlier occurrence in repeated random-token sequences ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . FV scores measure how much replacing a head’s output with its clean task mean restores correct-answer prediction when demonstration labels are shuffled ( Todd et al., 2024 ) . We use these scores to select heads for ablation. Full evaluation protocols are given in Section E.1 . We first compare induction behavior during language-model pretraining by averaging PS over the top 2% of heads at each checkpoint, reselecting them as training progresses. Checkpoint and aggregation details are given in Sections A.3 and E.1 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Induction Heads Contribute More to Context Use
blocks.zh: 4.2 上岗头更有助于背景使用

blocks.en: The trajectories and locations reveal how induction behavior develops and repeats across depth. A high prefix-matching score alone does not establish a head’s importance for ICL. We therefore ablate heads in the final models to test their contributions to few-shot performance and token loss.
blocks.zh: 轨迹和地点揭示出诱导行为如何发展并跨越深度重复. 单靠高前缀比分并不能确定头部对ICL的重要性. 因此,我们放弃了最终模式,以检验他们对几发性能和象征性损失的贡献。

blocks.en: Following the mean-ablation protocol of Yin and Steinhardt (2025) , we rank final-checkpoint heads by PS or FV score and replace the outputs of the selected 1–20% with mean activations. For looped models, each head application is counted and ablated separately. Here we focus on exclusive induction rankings, which first exclude the top 2% of FV heads, and exclusive FV rankings, which first exclude the top 2% of induction heads. We evaluate changes from each model’s unablated few-shot ICL (F1) and ICL-Score. Appendix F specifies the replacement means, indexing, and additional random controls.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Our experiments provide evidence that depth growing and looping favor learning from context. In the main language-model comparison, both achieve larger early-to-late token-loss reductions and higher GSM8K accuracy than the dense baseline. Grown and looped models also predict unseen formal languages more accurately. In controlled classification tasks, both acquire ICL earlier than a full-depth dense reference when labels are reassigned between sequences, and retain higher ICL accuracy when fixed associations can also be learned in the weights. Mechanistically, depth growth propagates early induction heads through layer duplication, with most of the strongest final heads descending from a small set of early ancestors. This produces repeated patterns across depth analogous to those in looped models, even though grown layers train independently after copying. Ablations in the main language-model comparison show that grown and looped models rely more on induction-ranked heads for few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Function-vector heads remain more important for few-shot performance in all models, suggesting that depth reuse shifts the relative contributions of these mechanisms. Together, these findings suggest that reusing computations across depth shapes how models acquire and retain ICL, as well as the attention mechanisms supporting it.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验提供了证据,证明深度增长和循环有利于从背景中学习。 在主要语言-模型比较中,既能实现更大规模的早期到后期的代号损失减少,又能比密集基线更精确地达到GSM8K. 成长和循环的模型也更准确地预测出看不见的正文. 在受控分类任务中,既能比在序列间再分配标签时的全深度密集引用更早获得ICL,又能保留更高的ICL精度,而当在权重中也可以得知固定关联. 在机械学上,深度生长通过层层重复来传播早期诱导头,而大多数最强的终极头从一小撮早期先祖而来. 这产生了与被环绕的模型相似的跨深度的重复模式,即使复制后已独立地发展出地层列车. 主要语言-模型比较中的偏差表明,已成型和被环绕的模型更多地依赖于被感应到的排名头来进行几发性能和后发性能的预测. 函数驱动器头对于所有模型的几发性能来说仍然更为重要,这表明深度再利用会改变这些机制的相对贡献。 这些调查结果共同表明,通过跨深度的计算再利用模型如何获得和保留ICL,以及支持其的关注机制.

blocks.en: The controlled tasks suggest that depth reuse shifts the competition between in-context and in-weights learning: grown and looped models retain higher ICL accuracy while attaining lower IWL accuracy than the full-depth dense reference. One possible explanation is that copying early context-dependent computations through growth, or repeatedly applying them through shared layers, makes a context-based solution less susceptible to being displaced as fixed associations are learned in the weights.
blocks.zh: 被控制的任务表明深度再利用会改变内文和内重学习之间的竞争:已成型和循环的模型保留了更高的ICL精度,同时达到比全深度密集参考更低的IWL精度. 一种可能的解释是,通过增长复制早期的上下文依赖计算,或通过共享层反复应用这些计算,使得基于上下文的解决方案较不易被取代,因为从权重中得知了固定的关联.

blocks.en: A.1 Training Setup
blocks.zh: A.1 培训设置

blocks.en: We train autoregressive, decoder-only Transformers with a next-token cross-entropy objective. The 360M and 1.7B configurations follow SmolLM ( Ben Allal et al., 2024 ) , and the 3B configuration follows SmolLM3 ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ) . All use pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU feed-forward layers, tied input and output embeddings, and no biases, dropout, or query/key normalization. Table 1 summarizes the dense reference configurations. Model sizes refer to these references; looped models have fewer unique parameters, and grown models reach the reference depth only during training. Comparisons between methods share the data and optimization settings within each size. The sizes differ in training budget, and the 3B configuration also changes the data, tokenizer, and context length, so they test robustness of observations across all these differences.

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate the grid-graph setting of Park et al. (2025) . Nine or sixteen distinct single-token nouns label the nodes of a 3 × 3 3\times 3 or 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid, respectively. Figure 11 shows both grid sizes with frequent-word labels for all three model sizes. A random walk is presented as a space-separated sequence of node words, without an additional delimiter. After each node, we sum the model’s full-vocabulary next-token probabilities over the words labeling that node’s valid neighbors. This probability mass is the graph task’s “accuracy”.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估了Park等人(2025年)的网格图设置。 9个或16个不同的单音节名词分别标注出一个3×3 3\times 3或4×4 4\times 4格的节点. 图11显示所有三个模型大小都带有常字标签的网格大小. 随机行走被呈现为节点单词的相隔空间序列,没有额外的分界符. 在每一个节点之后,我们用标有节点有效邻居的字句来总结模型的全相机下接概率。 这种概率质量是图任务的"精确".

blocks.en: The frequent-word comparison starts from a curated pool of 250 nouns spanning 18 semantic fields. For each tokenizer, we retain nouns that form a single token when preceded by a space and select the 64 with the lowest token IDs. The 360M/1.7B models use cosmo2, whereas 3B uses the SmolLM3 tokenizer; token ID serves as a frequency proxy. Each of 200 trials draws a new node-word assignment and random walks, with one sequence per starting node; scores are averaged over starting nodes within the trial. Models of a given size see the same trials. The horizontal axis counts node tokens in context, up to the native training context length, and bands show the standard error over trials. The one- and two-observation references measure the fraction of positions whose current node has already appeared as a source of a transition at least once or twice. They indicate when copying a previously observed successor becomes possible, rather than upper bounds on graph learning. The 3B comparison includes the dense, LIDAS , and looped models.

blocks.en: C.1 Task and Data

blocks.en: We use the released RegBench implementation of Akyürek et al. (2024) . Each sequence concatenates random walks from one DFA, separated by | . Candidate automata have 4–12 states, an alphabet of 4–18 symbols, and one to three outgoing transitions per state; they are minimized and trimmed before splitting. Each automaton supplies ten to nineteen strings of 1–49 symbols. The fixed dataset contains 40,000 training, 500 validation, and 500 test sequences, split by sampled automaton. blocks.en: D.3 Evaluation: ICL and IWL

blocks.en: The ICL probe uses four-shot, two-way sequences from the ten held-out classes, with new class-to-label assignments in each sequence. The context contains four distinct exemplars per class, and the query is a fifth exemplar of one of them. We report accuracy with the argmax restricted to logits 0 and 1 (chance 1 / 2 1/2 ). Success therefore requires using the current context for a class never encountered in training. The IWL probe instead samples the query uniformly from the 1613 training classes, uses its fixed training label, and guarantees that its class is absent from the eight context examples. It reports the unrestricted argmax over all 1623 outputs, consequently, uniform guessing over that output space gives chance 1 / 1623 1/1623 . The IWL probe is used only for the fixed-label setting.

blocks.en: We implement the head diagnostics of Yin and Steinhardt (2025) and Aoyama et al. (2026) on converted language-model checkpoints, using fp32 weights and TF32 matrix multiplications. The same prompts and random sequences are reused across checkpoints and models within each size. Attention-head outputs are measured immediately before the attention output projection. For looped models, each application of a shared head is evaluated separately, since its input and causal role can differ across passes.
blocks.zh: 我们采用fp32重量和TF32矩阵乘法,对转换后的语言型检查站实施殷和斯泰因哈特(2025年)和青山等头部诊断. 同样的提示和随机顺序在每一个大小的检查站和模型中重复使用。 注意头产出在注意头产出预测之前就加以衡量。 对于循环模型,共享头的每个应用都会单独评价,因为其输入和因果作用可能因路由而异.

For a second-half token, the induction target is the token following its earlier occurrence. Prefix-matching score (PS) is the mean attention probability assigned to the target position, averaged over second-half positions and sequences. With zero-based sequence positions p ∈ { 51 , … , 100 } p\in\{51,\ldots,100\} , the target position is p − 49 p-49 ; the last position uses the cyclic continuation x 1 x_{1} .

blocks.en: Following Todd et al. (2024) ; Yin and Steinhardt (2025) , we estimate a function-vector (FV) score on 29 training tasks using ten demonstrations and 100 clean and 100 corrupted prompts per task. We do not filter tasks or prompts by performance on clean prompts. For each head and task, we compute its mean last-token output on clean prompts. We then shuffle the demonstration labels and replace that head’s last-token output with the clean task mean. The FV score is the patched minus unpatched probability of the correct first answer token on the corrupted prompt, averaged over prompts and then tasks. Head selection therefore uses a causal intervention on demonstration-based task execution, rather than the attention pattern alone.

blocks.en: Figure 19 evaluates intermediate predictions at each exit depth l l , with the horizontal axis normalized to l / L l/L . For each generated token, we run only the first l l layers and decode their residual stream. The logit lens applies the full model’s final normalization and unembedding directly. The tuned lens ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) first applies a learned affine residual translator h ↦ h + W l ​ h + b l h\mapsto h+W_{l}h+b_{l} . Translators are initialized at zero, so the initial lens is the identity, and the language model remains frozen.

blocks.en: Each model’s translators are trained on its own FineWeb-Edu pretraining source for 250 optimizer steps with 2 18 2^{18} tokens per step, minimizing KL divergence from the full model’s next-token distribution to the translated intermediate prediction. Training uses SGD with Nesterov momentum 0.9, initial learning rate 0.1 with linear decay, weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , gradient clipping at norm 1, and bf16 autocast. Tokenization and document masking follow the corresponding pretraining setup. Translator index l l decodes the residual entering layer l l (equivalently, after l l completed layers); the full-depth exit uses the original readout without a translator.

blocks.en: We run the same nineteen-task, ten-shot F1 evaluation at each exit depth.
